# Welcome to my website!

My name is Emily Biondi. I am a Certified Nurse Midwife (CNM) and PhD candidate in Biomedical Engineering at Case Western Reserve University. I am passionate about women's health and research into caring for women throughout the lifespan from puberty through post-menopause. 

My research interests include obstetrics and gynecology with a special focus on pelvic floor dysfunction. I am currently working in Dr. Dennis Bourbeau's lab which focuses on autonomic nervous system restoration in the pelvis. I am especially interested in the use of sacral neural modulation to modulate genitourinary responses.  

I previously worked as an out-of-hospital CNM at a birth center providing full-scope midwifery care including comprehensive reproductive work-ups, family planning, and gynecologic services.  

Please feel free to contact me with any questions at eam206@case.edu.
